The '''island spires''' of [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] were large rock formations that thrust out of the planet-wide ocean. These were the homes of the residents of Bestine IV, who struggled for years to turn them into island paradises.

[[Jahnae Camp]] was built on one of them.
